node.statement: Smoothness of the descended inversion. The scalar action is smooth, free on calU_e, and the N>1 quotient-manifold structure of lem-stage1-quotient-manifold-package is the smooth orbit quotient. Since sigma is smooth, preserves calU_e, and is equivariant for the automorphism c |-> conj(c) of U(1), the representative-independent breve-sigma is smooth in quotient charts (equivalently, p o sigma=breve-sigma o p and local smooth sections of the quotient submersion give smooth local expressions); for N=1 it is the unique smooth self-map of a point.
